Method of Attack: Infects vulnerable Ruckus Wireless Admin panels via malicious HTTP GET requests
Downloads additional script from hardcoded URL for propagation
Establishes communication with C2 server using SOCKS proxying protocol to bypass firewalls
Supports 12 DDoS attack modes including tcp-raw, tcp-socket, tcp-cnc, tcp-handshake, udp-plain, udp-game, udp-ovh, udp-raw, udp-vse, udp-dstat, udp-bypass, and icmp-echo
Receives commands from C2 server to perform DDoS attacks on target IP and port
Impacted Systems: Ruckus Wireless Admin panels version 10.4 and older
Attack Vector: Unauthenticated HTTP GET requests to vulnerable devices
Indicators of Compromise: Additional script downloaded from hardcoded URL
Communication with C2 server via SOCKS proxy
